verdict.rationale: Reflect documents backlinks/bidirectional linking ([[ ]]) and note filtering by date, tags, backlinks, daily notes, and pinned status, which supports exploring connections and narrowing scope. However, there is no evidence of an actual interactive visual graph view of the knowledge base (a node-and-edge graph), which is central to the story. Missing for 10: explicit graph-visualization UI, ability to visually filter/pan the graph, independent confirmation of a graph feature.
